input.quote: (vi) Return of Materials. Within ninety (90) days after the end of the Wind-down Period, upon request by Array, Ono shall either deliver to Array or destroy all tangible items comprising, bearing or containing trademarks of Array (including the Product Trademarks), trade names, patents, copyrights, designs, drawings, formulas or other Data, photographs, samples, literature, sales and promotional aids ("Product Materials") and Confidential Information of Array, that is in Ono's possession, subject to Ono's right to keep one (1) copy for archiving purposes.
input.rationale: Article XIV is a detailed wind-down regime, but every operative transition and return obligation runs against us: we must transition studies, keep distributing, assign Regulatory Filings and hand over Data and Ono Know-How (p0659), and return or destroy Array's Materials and Confidential Information (p0662). The only mutual language is the general cooperation covenant in Section 14.2(a)(iv) (p0660), which merely transitions the Product back to Array. Nothing obliges Array to give us transition assistance or to return, delete and certify deletion of our Data and Confidential Information, so the rule's clause is absent. We therefore insert a reciprocal Section 14.2(a)(x) at the preferred level: up to six (6) months' assistance at Array's then-current rates, return of our Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

ops.text: (x) Transition Assistance and Return of Ono Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (a) at Ono's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Array's then-current rates; (b) return all Data and other Confidential Information of Ono ("Customer Data") in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination; and (c) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV's exit mechanics run only in Array's favour, so we add a reciprocal sub-paragraph: up to six (6) months' transition assistance at Array's then-current rates, return of our Data and Confidential Information in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. If Array prefers, we can fall back to 90 days' assistance with the same 30-day data export.
proposal.summary: Insert reciprocal Array transition-assistance and Customer Data return/deletion as new Section 14.2(a)(x)
